rules.name: Poison Shot
rules.description: As a special Shoot Attack Boost, Karliah may add the Poison Keyword to any Ranged Attack made with a Bow. Choose the type of poison before making the Attack roll.

rules.name: Cool Head
rules.description: If Mercer is the Party Champion, friendly models within 6" add [GREEN] to their Morale Checks.

rules.name: Natural Survivor
rules.description: When Mercer suffers 2 or more points of damage from a single enemy Attack, roll [SKILL DIE]. On a [CRITICAL], reduce the amount of damage inflicted by 1 point.

rules.name: Go-Between
rules.description: Brynjolf may target Faction Heroes with Commands, even if he is not the Party Champion.

rules.name: Lurk in the Shadows
rules.description: Delvin and all friendly Thieves' Guild models within 3" gain the Regenerate Health keyword as long as they have a Hidden Token.

rules.name: Spotter
rules.description: Friendly models within 6" and Line of Sight of Niruin may reroll blanks on their Effect Dice when performing Shoot Actions.

rules.name: Dirty Fighter
rules.description: When Vex is hit by a Melee Attack (before applying damage), she may immediately take an Agility Attribute Test. If successful, the Attacker receives a Slowed Token as soon as the Attack is resolved.

rules.name: Lockpicking Trainer
rules.description: Friendly models gain the Expert Locks (1) Perk while they're within 3" of Vex.
